0.original: Tsuzura watches intently as her companion polishes a shell.

26.original: Deliver the cotton kerchiefs to Tsuzura's sister.

48.original: You must be terribly bored if you have nothing better to do than stand there and watch us. How about I give you some work?

49.original: My sister left to clean the cotton kerchiefs we use to polish our shells but she is slow to return.

50.original: Might you go and check the shores around the eastern cove to make sure nothing has happened to her?

51.original: My sister went to wash our cotton kerchiefs but she does not return. Please check the area around the eastern cove to make sure no ill has befallen her.

52.original: <hex:02080FE905FF064D6164616DFF0453697203>, please. I do not mean to be rude, but I have not the time to entertain anyone right now. The kerchiefs I was sent to wash were swept away by a strong gust of wind, and I must retrieve them before they are lost forever!

53.original: Tsuzura sent you to look for me? <sigh> My sister has always been impatient. I must hurry. I do not want to be scolded again. Please, might you assist me in my search?

54.original: I will inspect the deep seas, so can you scour the coast? Let us meet back here once we are finished.

56.original: One... Two... Three... That should be everything! Thank the kami! Thank <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>! Your keen eyes have spared my ears another long-winded lecture.

57.original: I always come here to launder our kerchiefs because they become much softer when they are dried under the sun.

58.original: Unfortunately, they have gotten damp, so I will have to hang them out again. If you are returning to Tamamizu, please tell my sister I will be just a bit longer.

59.original: My sister lost the kerchiefs <hex:021A020203>again<hex:021A020103>? <sigh> Thank you for helping her gather them.

60.original: Ah, you are staring again. You want to know whose shell we are polishing, I take it? This one once belonged to a venerated ancestor of ours, who was reckoned a sage among our people.

61.original: Upon his death, his soul took up residence in his shell. We hang it on the gate to our village that he might continue to keep us safe.

62.original: After watching over Tamamizu for a few centuries, his soul will eventually depart from this place, and he will be reborn as a kami.

63.original: To thank him for his years of dedicated service, we regularly take down and polish his shell.

64.original: For your help, we will ask that he also protect you. Thank you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>!
